summary: Read-only backend check of the deterministic closing-line fix. 7 of 8 tests pass. (1) cs.build_vapi_payload with real settings from local Mongo for en-IN, hi-IN (Delhi) and bn-IN (West Bengal): tools[0] is file_disposition with 8 request-complete messages (one per settings.dispositions code, conditions [{param:'disposition',operator:'eq',value:CODE}], role assistant, content == script_lines()[d.close]) plus 1 request-failed (denial_close). All 9 have endCallAfterSpokenEnabled true, contain no '{' or '}', and are not empty. CALLBACK_REQUESTED -> callback_close (en is exactly 'Of course, no problem at all. We will call you back at a better time. Thank you!'). RPC_CONFIRMED -> confirmed_close, which has no 'representative'. (2) The payload system prompt for hi and bn contains 'call `file_disposition` WITHOUT speaking first', '"goodbye"', '"wait a minute"', the voicemail rule 'end the call (do not file a disposition)' and 'do not call endCall'. (3) GET prompt-preview for campaign 6ad2faad17b693b316bc636b (Surath Dey / Tata Capital / West Bengal) returns 200, language bn-IN, includes the new rule 6, and has no unrendered {{ }}. (4) A webhook call with a bad token returns 401. (5) FAILED: POST /api/vapi/webhook tool-calls with the valid token and a non-existent attempt_id 000000000000000000000000 returns 200 {'ok':true,'ignored':'unknown call'} and no 'results'. The handler returns early on the unknown-attempt lookup (server.py lines 488-490), before it reaches the tool-calls branch. No attempt was modified. No calls were placed, no assistants were created and no settings were saved.

minor.issue: When the attempt is unknown (no provider_call_id match and no valid metadata.attempt_id), the response is {'ok':true,'ignored':'unknown call'} with no 'results' array. The review expected results[0].result to contain 'closing line is spoken automatically', so this fails. Real-world effect: if Vapi receives a tool response with no results for that toolCallId, it can treat the call as failed. The request-failed fallback would then speak denial_close instead of the correct closing line, such as callback_close. Today this only happens for unmatched calls (for example dashboard or test calls, or a lookup race), but the fix is cheap: in server.py, move the tool-calls handling ahead of the unknown-doc early return, or return {'results':[{toolCallId, result:'Disposition recorded. The closing line is spoken automatically; do not say anything else.'}]} for unknown calls without writing to the DB.

action_items: server.py vapi_webhook: for type == 'tool-calls', always return a results entry per toolCallId, even when the attempt is unknown. Skip only the DB writes. Without this, Vapi may fall back to request-failed and speak denial_close.

Optional prompt hardening in rpi_engine.build_system_prompt: the APPROVED LINES header says 'say them as written' and also lists every *_CLOSE line. Exclude the close keys from that list, or label them 'spoken automatically by the system - never say these yourself'. Otherwise the model may speak a close itself and Vapi then speaks it again (double close).
critical_code_review_comments: call_service.closing_messages: the request-failed message has no 'role' key while the request-complete messages have role 'assistant'. This is harmless per the main agent's 201 schema validation, but it is inconsistent.

closing_messages silently skips a disposition whose close key renders empty (lines.get(d.close) is falsy). In that case the request-complete count drops below the number of dispositions and Vapi says nothing for that code. Consider falling back to denial_close.

rpi_engine rule 5 (voicemail -> end the call) relies on the endCall tool, while rule 5 of the flow says 'do not call endCall'. Both are scoped correctly (voicemail vs disposition), but the wording could confuse the LLM. Consider 'except for voicemail' in flow step 5.
The 'Jev route' playbook instruction does not apply: there is no such route in this app (grep found nothing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Vapi mode: stay read-only (no launches, resumes or retries, no place_call, no Vapi assistant creation, no settings saves). Run tests/test_closing_messages_readonly.py with -n0 to see the printed closing lines. It builds payloads in-process from the local Mongo settings. No state maps to en-IN (fallback is not en-IN), so the en case forces the language directly. The webhook unknown-attempt test fails until server.py returns tool results for unknown calls.
rca of the issue: Unknown-call early return: vapi_webhook looks up the attempt and returns {'ok':true,'ignored'} before checking msg.type. The tool-calls branch, which builds the 'results' list Vapi needs, is never reached for unmatched calls. Reproduce: POST /api/vapi/webhook?token=<valid> with message.type 'tool-calls', call.id 'x' and metadata.attempt_id '0'*24. Fix: handle tool-calls before the doc check and do DB writes only if doc exists.
